Parts.Description: A green lawn, a sand yard before the gate and a flagstone island in a deep blue moat.
Parts.Name: Castle Grounds

Parts.Description: Twin round towers with blue roofs and a high arch: the Knight Shiba guards the castle gate.
Parts.Name: Barbican Gate

Parts.Description: Four tall banners of the royal house, red and blue, flapping around the knight's yard.
Parts.Name: Heraldic Banners

Parts.Description: A heavy plank drawbridge on iron chains between two gate posts, over the moat.
Parts.Name: Drawbridge

Parts.Description: Three striped stalls, a hand cart, barrels and crates: the village sells apples and swords.
Parts.Name: Village Market

Parts.Description: Thick grey walls with corner towers and a gate arch ring the island: the keep waits inside.
Parts.Name: Curtain Walls

Parts.Description: A stone smithy with a chimney, a glowing forge, an anvil and racks of swords and shields.
Parts.Name: Royal Armory

Parts.Description: A timber barn with hay and a trough, a brown war horse and a fenced yard.
Parts.Name: Royal Stables

Parts.Description: Straw dummies with wooden shields, hay bales, a practice target and a rack of wooden swords.
Parts.Name: Training Yard

Parts.Description: A round stone fountain with a stone knight on top, four little pillars and clear blue water.
Parts.Name: Courtyard Fountain

Parts.Description: A striped tent with a golden pole and a pennant, a throne inside and a red rug.
Parts.Name: Royal Pavilion

Parts.Description: Three round targets before a hay backstop, a rope line to shoot from and a quiver rack.
Parts.Name: Archery Range

Parts.Description: Clipped green hedges around red and yellow rose beds, a white rose arch and a stone bench.
Parts.Name: Rose Garden

Parts.Description: A little stone chapel with a blue roof, a round apse, a tall bell tower and a golden cross.
Parts.Name: Castle Chapel

Parts.Description: A striped jousting barrier in a sand arena, a covered grandstand and lances in a rack.
Parts.Name: Tournament Lists

Parts.Description: The king's tall stone keep with four round corner turrets, blue roofs and a royal flag on top.
Parts.Name: Great Keep

Parts.Description: A stone windmill with a blue cap and big wooden sails, flour sacks by the door.
Parts.Name: Village Windmill

Parts.Description: An open pavilion on four pillars with a golden roof, a big round table and four knight chairs.
Parts.Name: Round Table Hall

Parts.Description: A huge wooden trebuchet with a stone counterweight and a pile of boulders ready to fly.
Parts.Name: Siege Trebuchet

Parts.Description: The showpiece: a giant sword of steel and gold stuck in a mossy rock, waiting for the true king.
Parts.Name: Sword in the Stone
